name: codex-codecollab
description: Capture each turn to your becos brain and recall relevant memory before every prompt.

interface.shortDescription: v0.7.0 · Session memory: capture + recall + backfill past sessions
interface.longDescription: On each user prompt, codecollab calls your becos brain (vonic_query) and injects relevant memory as additional context. On each turn it saves the prompt and assistant reply, with common secret patterns redacted and code blocks moved out of the text; code blocks from the reply are saved separately, also redacted and size-capped (VONIC_CAPTURE_CODE=0 stops that). It also sends the repository-relative paths of files you edited and the repository, branch, author and commit (VONIC_CAPTURE_FILES=0 drops the paths). Never sends reasoning, commands, command output, tool I/O, or diffs. Redaction is best effort, not a guarantee.
defaultPrompt: Recall relevant context from my becos brain before answering my request.
